hooks.name: aidlc-lean-guard
hooks.description: AI-DLC Lean: before a file write or command, checks the approvals code needs (IDEATION when Ideation is used, requirements and application design; in regulated mode also the unit's code-generation plan), protected tests, contract ownership, the files only the tool writes, dangerous commands and the verify-before-commit rule. Read tools are not checked; shell commands that touch the kit's records (even reads such as cat aidlc-docs/lean.json) may be blocked.
